CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS vets (
  id INTEGER GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  first_name VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL,
  last_name VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL
);

CREATE INDEX idx_vets_last_name ON vets(last_name);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS specialties (
  id INTEGER GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  name VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL
);

CREATE INDEX idx_specialties_name ON specialties(name);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS vet_specialties (
  vet_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  specialty_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  FOREIGN KEY (vet_id) REFERENCES vets(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  FOREIGN KEY (specialty_id) REFERENCES specialties(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  UNIQUE (vet_id, specialty_id)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS types (
  id INTEGER GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  name VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL
);

CREATE INDEX idx_types_name ON types(name);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS owners (
  id INTEGER GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  first_name VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL,
  last_name VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL,
  title VARCHAR(10),
  address VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  address_line1 VARCHAR(255),
  address_line2 VARCHAR(255),
  city VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL,
  telephone VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
  email VARCHAR(255),
  postcode VARCHAR(10),
  registration_date DATE,
  birth_date DATE,
  customer_code VARCHAR(20),
  membership_number VARCHAR(32),
  household_id VARCHAR(64),
  namesake_count INTEGER,
  household_size INTEGER,
  membership_level_cap INTEGER,
  bulk_signup_warning BOOLEAN,
  capacity_warning BOOLEAN,
  possible_duplicate BOOLEAN,
  possible_duplicate_of INTEGER,
  deleted BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE NOT NULL
);

CREATE INDEX idx_owners_last_name ON owners(last_name);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS pets (
  id INTEGER GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  name VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL,
  birth_date DATE NOT NULL,
  type_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  owner_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  FOREIGN KEY (owner_id) REFERENCES owners(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  FOREIGN KEY (type_id) REFERENCES types(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
);

CREATE INDEX idx_pets_name ON pets(name);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS visits (
  id INTEGER GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  pet_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  visit_date DATE NOT NULL,
  description VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  FOREIGN KEY (pet_id) REFERENCES pets(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (
  username VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
  password VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  enabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS roles (
  id INTEGER GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  username VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
  role VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE (role, username),
  FOREIGN KEY (username) REFERENCES users(username) ON DELETE CASCADE
);

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The optional honorific title of the pet owner. When supplied it must be one
            of MR, MRS, MS or DR, and is used to compose the owner's 'salutation'.
          type: string
          enum:
            - MR
            - MRS
            - MS
            - DR
          example: 'DR'
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted on input for backward
            compatibility; when the structured 'addressLine1' is supplied it is
            preferred. On output this is the composed, normalized address: the
            normalized 'addressLine1' with a single space and the normalized
            'addressLine2' appended when an 'addressLine2' is present.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the owner's structured postal address. Optional;
            preferred over the flat 'address' when supplied (non-blank). Stored and
            returned normalized (trimmed, whitespace collapsed, upper-cased, common
            abbreviations expanded).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the owner's structured postal address (unit,
            suite, etc.). When present it is normalized and appended to the composed
            'address' after a single space.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Suite 200'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when supplied it must be a
            syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; when supplied it must be four digits
            and, when the city maps to a known region (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC,
            Brisbane->QLD), fall within that region's range (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099,
            QLD 4000-4099). A city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode.
            Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional on
            create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2013-01-01'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The owner's date of birth, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional; when supplied
            the owner's 'ageBand' is derived from it (computed against the registrationDate).
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, marks this owner as a declared member of an existing household (same
            last name and postcode); such a declared household member is not flagged as a
            possible duplicate. Owners sharing a household are created regardless of this flag
            (only an exact identityKey match is rejected); it only suppresses the
            possible-duplicate flag. Write-only; not returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: The owner's canonical URI, '/api/owners/' followed by the owner id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation: the 'title' followed by a single space and the
                lastName when a title was supplied, otherwise just the lastName.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>' where CITY3
                is the upper-cased first three letters of city, LAST3 the upper-cased first
                three letters of lastName and NNNN a per-city 4-digit zero-padded sequence
                (one more than the owners already in that city) assigned at creation time.
              type: string
              example: 'SYD-SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits contained
                in customerCode, derived at read time.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 7
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A deterministic identifier shared by owners that belong to the same household:
                the first 12 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over
                (normalizedLastName + '|' + postcode), so every owner with the same last name
                and postcode derives the same id automatically. Null for an owner with no postcode.
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The single derived key all duplicate detection is expressed through: the
                lower-case hex SHA-256 of
                (normalizedTelephone + '|' + (email or empty) + '|' + soundex(lastName)).
                A create request is rejected with 409 only when its whole identityKey equals
                an existing owner's (soft-deleted owners are ignored, and the disposable-email
                blocklist is applied first). Owners with the same last name and postcode but
                differing in telephone or email have different identityKeys and are all
                allowed; a new member's standing is instead bounded by the household
                membershipLevel ceiling.
              type: string
              example: 'a3f1c9d2b4e5f60718293a4b5c6d7e8f90a1b2c3d4e5f60718293a4b5c6d7e8f'
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when this owner, though not a hard duplicate, matched an existing
                owner's lastName soundex and postcode while its whole identityKey differed
                at the time it was created; false otherwise. A declared household member
                (created with 'sharesHousehold' true) is never flagged. Assigned at creation time.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this one soft-matched on lastName and
                postcode (with a different telephone) at creation time. Null when
                'possibleDuplicate' is false.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that shared this owner's firstName and
                lastName (case-insensitively) at the time this owner was created.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where YY
                is the last two digits of the fiscal year (starting 1 July) that contains the
                business-day-adjusted registrationDate. Assigned at creation time.
              type: string
              example: 'SYD-SMI-0007-M27'
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points: starts at 0, +2 when an email is
                present, +1 when namesakeCount is 0, +2 for a household of 3 or
                more members (counted at creation), and +3 for tenure of at least one
                elapsed fiscal year (fiscal years start 1 July) since registrationDate.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, derived from membershipPoints:
                1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3, 3 for 4-5, 4 for 6 or more. Capped at
                creation to at most one above the maximum membershipLevel among the
                owner's existing household members (no cap when there were none).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The owner's fiscal year, formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the last two digits
                of the fiscal year (starting 1 July) that contains the business-day-adjusted
                registrationDate. A date on or after 1 July belongs to the fiscal year named
                for the following calendar year (e.g. 2026-07-01 is 'FY27'); January to June
                belongs to its own calendar year. Null when no registrationDate is stored.
              type: string
              example: 'FY27'
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's region, derived at read time from the city via a fixed
                city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD),
                or 'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's segment, derived at read time and formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>'.
                TIER is 'PREMIUM' when membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'.
                AREA is 'METRO' when the locality is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD),
                otherwise 'REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - PREMIUM_METRO
                - PREMIUM_REGIONAL
                - STANDARD_METRO
                - STANDARD_REGIONAL
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The owner's timezone, derived at read time as the IANA name for the
                owner's region via a fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney,
                VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Null when the region
                has no known timezone.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners had already been created on this owner's
                registration business day at the time this owner was created; false
                otherwise. Assigned at creation time.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                True when this owner's city already held between 40 and 49 owners
                (approaching the per-city hard limit of 50) at the time this owner was
                created; false otherwise. Assigned at creation time.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived at read time:
                'EMAIL' when an email is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band, derived at read time from 'birthDate' computed
                against 'registrationDate': 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' when 18 to 64,
                'SENIOR' when 65 or older. Null when no birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans: the country code,
                a space, then the national digits grouped in threes (e.g. '+61412345678'
                becomes '+61 412 345 678'). Derived at read time; the raw 'telephone'
                stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                Whether this owner has been soft-deleted. A newly created owner is false;
                DELETE /owners/{id} marks the owner deleted (true) while retaining the record,
                and the create endpoint's duplicate and identity checks ignore deleted owners.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

      operationId: failingRequest
      summary: Always fails

          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string

          description: Bad request.

            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        500:
          description: Server error.

            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The optional honorific title of the pet owner. When supplied it must be one
            of MR, MRS, MS or DR, and is used to compose the owner's 'salutation'.
          type: string
          enum:
            - MR
            - MRS
            - MS
            - DR
          example: 'DR'
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted on input for backward
            compatibility; when the structured 'addressLine1' is supplied it is
            preferred. On output this is the composed, normalized address: the
            normalized 'addressLine1' with a single space and the normalized
            'addressLine2' appended when an 'addressLine2' is present.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the owner's structured postal address. Optional;
            preferred over the flat 'address' when supplied (non-blank). Stored and
            returned normalized (trimmed, whitespace collapsed, upper-cased, common
            abbreviations expanded).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the owner's structured postal address (unit,
            suite, etc.). When present it is normalized and appended to the composed
            'address' after a single space.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Suite 200'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when supplied it must be a
            syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; when supplied it must be four digits
            and, when the city maps to a known region (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC,
            Brisbane->QLD), fall within that region's range (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099,
            QLD 4000-4099). A city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode.
            Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional on
            create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2013-01-01'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The owner's date of birth, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional; when supplied
            the owner's 'ageBand' is derived from it (computed against the registrationDate).
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, marks this owner as a declared member of an existing household (same
            last name and postcode); such a declared household member is not flagged as a
            possible duplicate. Owners sharing a household are created regardless of this flag
            (only an exact identityKey match is rejected); it only suppresses the
            possible-duplicate flag. Write-only; not returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: The owner's canonical URI, '/api/owners/' followed by the owner id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation: the 'title' followed by a single space and the
                lastName when a title was supplied, otherwise just the lastName.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            memberId:
              title: Member ID
              description: >-
                The owner's unified member id, formatted '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>' and assigned at
                creation time. REGION is the owner's region (NSW, VIC, QLD, or UNKNOWN). FY is the
                two-digit fiscal year (fiscal years start 1 July) that contains the
                business-day-adjusted registrationDate. HASH8 is the first 8 upper-case hex
                characters of SHA-256 over (normalizedTelephone + lastName). CHK is a single Luhn
                check digit over the digits of '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'. On the rare collision with an
                existing member id, a '-<n>' suffix (n of 2 or more) is appended.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW271A2B3C4D5'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A deterministic identifier shared by owners that belong to the same household:
                the first 12 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over
                (normalizedLastName + '|' + postcode), so every owner with the same last name
                and postcode derives the same id automatically. Null for an owner with no postcode.
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The single derived key all duplicate detection is expressed through: the
                lower-case hex SHA-256 of
                (normalizedTelephone + '|' + (email or empty) + '|' + soundex(lastName)).
                A create request is rejected with 409 only when its whole identityKey equals
                an existing owner's (soft-deleted owners are ignored, and the disposable-email
                blocklist is applied first). Owners with the same last name and postcode but
                differing in telephone or email have different identityKeys and are all
                allowed; a new member's standing is instead bounded by the household
                membershipLevel ceiling.
              type: string
              example: 'a3f1c9d2b4e5f60718293a4b5c6d7e8f90a1b2c3d4e5f60718293a4b5c6d7e8f'
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when this owner, though not a hard duplicate, matched an existing
                owner's lastName soundex and postcode while its whole identityKey differed
                at the time it was created; false otherwise. A declared household member
                (created with 'sharesHousehold' true) is never flagged. Assigned at creation time.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this one soft-matched on lastName and
                postcode (with a different telephone) at creation time. Null when
                'possibleDuplicate' is false.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that shared this owner's firstName and
                lastName (case-insensitively) at the time this owner was created.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where YY
                is the last two digits of the fiscal year (starting 1 July) that contains the
                business-day-adjusted registrationDate. Assigned at creation time.
              type: string
              example: 'SYD-SMI-0007-M27'
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points: starts at 0, +2 when an email is
                present, +1 when namesakeCount is 0, +2 for a household of 3 or
                more members (counted at creation), and +3 for tenure of at least one
                elapsed fiscal year (fiscal years start 1 July) since registrationDate.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, derived from membershipPoints:
                1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3, 3 for 4-5, 4 for 6 or more. Capped at
                creation to at most one above the maximum membershipLevel among the
                owner's existing household members (no cap when there were none).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The owner's fiscal year, formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the last two digits
                of the fiscal year (starting 1 July) that contains the business-day-adjusted
                registrationDate. A date on or after 1 July belongs to the fiscal year named
                for the following calendar year (e.g. 2026-07-01 is 'FY27'); January to June
                belongs to its own calendar year. Null when no registrationDate is stored.
              type: string
              example: 'FY27'
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's region, derived at read time from the city via a fixed
                city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD),
                or 'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's segment, derived at read time and formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>'.
                TIER is 'PREMIUM' when membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'.
                AREA is 'METRO' when the locality is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD),
                otherwise 'REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - PREMIUM_METRO
                - PREMIUM_REGIONAL
                - STANDARD_METRO
                - STANDARD_REGIONAL
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The owner's timezone, derived at read time as the IANA name for the
                owner's region via a fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney,
                VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Null when the region
                has no known timezone.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners had already been created on this owner's
                registration business day at the time this owner was created; false
                otherwise. Assigned at creation time.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                True when this owner's city already held between 40 and 49 owners
                (approaching the per-city hard limit of 50) at the time this owner was
                created; false otherwise. Assigned at creation time.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived at read time:
                'EMAIL' when an email is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band, derived at read time from 'birthDate' computed
                against 'registrationDate': 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' when 18 to 64,
                'SENIOR' when 65 or older. Null when no birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans: the country code,
                a space, then the national digits grouped in threes (e.g. '+61412345678'
                becomes '+61 412 345 678'). Derived at read time; the raw 'telephone'
                stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                Whether this owner has been soft-deleted. A newly created owner is false;
                DELETE /owners/{id} marks the owner deleted (true) while retaining the record,
                and the create endpoint's duplicate and identity checks ignore deleted owners.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
    OwnerPage:
      title: Owner page
      description: A page of pet owners.
      type: object
      properties:
        content:
          title: Content

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The optional honorific title of the pet owner. When supplied it must be one
            of MR, MRS, MS or DR, and is used to compose the owner's 'salutation'.
          type: string
          enum:
            - MR
            - MRS
            - MS
            - DR
          example: 'DR'
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted on input for backward
            compatibility; when the structured 'addressLine1' is supplied it is
            preferred. On output this is the composed, normalized address: the
            normalized 'addressLine1' with a single space and the normalized
            'addressLine2' appended when an 'addressLine2' is present.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the owner's structured postal address. Optional;
            preferred over the flat 'address' when supplied (non-blank). Stored and
            returned normalized (trimmed, whitespace collapsed, upper-cased, common
            abbreviations expanded).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the owner's structured postal address (unit,
            suite, etc.). When present it is normalized and appended to the composed
            'address' after a single space.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Suite 200'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when supplied it must be a
            syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; when supplied it must be four digits
            and, when the city maps to a known region (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC,
            Brisbane->QLD), fall within that region's range (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099,
            QLD 4000-4099). A city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode.
            Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional on
            create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2013-01-01'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The owner's date of birth, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional; when supplied
            the owner's 'ageBand' is derived from it (computed against the registrationDate).
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, marks this owner as a declared member of an existing household (same
            last name and postcode); such a declared household member is not flagged as a
            possible duplicate. Owners sharing a household are created regardless of this flag
            (only an exact identityKey match is rejected); it only suppresses the
            possible-duplicate flag. Write-only; not returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: The owner's canonical URI, '/api/owners/' followed by the owner id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation: the 'title' followed by a single space and the
                lastName when a title was supplied, otherwise just the lastName.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            memberId:
              title: Member ID
              description: >-
                The owner's unified member id, formatted '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>' and assigned at
                creation time. REGION is the owner's region (NSW, VIC, QLD, or UNKNOWN). FY is the
                two-digit fiscal year (fiscal years start 1 July) that contains the
                business-day-adjusted registrationDate. HASH8 is the first 8 upper-case hex
                characters of SHA-256 over (normalizedTelephone + lastName). CHK is a single Luhn
                check digit over the digits of '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'. On the rare collision with an
                existing member id, a '-<n>' suffix (n of 2 or more) is appended.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW271A2B3C4D5'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A deterministic identifier shared by owners that belong to the same household:
                the first 12 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over
                (normalizedLastName + '|' + postcode), so every owner with the same last name
                and postcode derives the same id automatically. Null for an owner with no postcode.
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The single derived key all duplicate detection is expressed through: the
                lower-case hex SHA-256 of
                (normalizedTelephone + '|' + (email or empty) + '|' + soundex(lastName)).
                A create request is rejected with 409 only when its whole identityKey equals
                an existing owner's (soft-deleted owners are ignored, and the disposable-email
                blocklist is applied first). Owners with the same last name and postcode but
                differing in telephone or email have different identityKeys and are all
                allowed; a new member's standing is instead bounded by the household
                membershipLevel ceiling.
              type: string
              example: 'a3f1c9d2b4e5f60718293a4b5c6d7e8f90a1b2c3d4e5f60718293a4b5c6d7e8f'
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when this owner, though not a hard duplicate, matched an existing
                owner's lastName soundex and postcode while its whole identityKey differed
                at the time it was created; false otherwise. A declared household member
                (created with 'sharesHousehold' true) is never flagged. Assigned at creation time.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this one soft-matched on lastName and
                postcode (with a different telephone) at creation time. Null when
                'possibleDuplicate' is false.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that shared this owner's firstName and
                lastName (case-insensitively) at the time this owner was created.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points: starts at 0, +2 when an email is
                present, +1 when namesakeCount is 0, +2 for a household of 3 or
                more members (counted at creation), and +3 for tenure of at least one
                elapsed fiscal year (fiscal years start 1 July) since registrationDate.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, derived from membershipPoints:
                1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3, 3 for 4-5, 4 for 6 or more. Capped at
                creation to at most one above the maximum membershipLevel among the
                owner's existing household members (no cap when there were none).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The owner's fiscal year, formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the last two digits
                of the fiscal year (starting 1 July) that contains the business-day-adjusted
                registrationDate. A date on or after 1 July belongs to the fiscal year named
                for the following calendar year (e.g. 2026-07-01 is 'FY27'); January to June
                belongs to its own calendar year. Null when no registrationDate is stored.
              type: string
              example: 'FY27'
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's region, derived at read time from the city via a fixed
                city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD),
                or 'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's segment, derived at read time and formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>'.
                TIER is 'PREMIUM' when membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'.
                AREA is 'METRO' when the locality is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD),
                otherwise 'REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - PREMIUM_METRO
                - PREMIUM_REGIONAL
                - STANDARD_METRO
                - STANDARD_REGIONAL
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The owner's timezone, derived at read time as the IANA name for the
                owner's region via a fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney,
                VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Null when the region
                has no known timezone.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners had already been created on this owner's
                registration business day at the time this owner was created; false
                otherwise. Assigned at creation time.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                True when this owner's city already held between 40 and 49 owners
                (approaching the per-city hard limit of 50) at the time this owner was
                created; false otherwise. Assigned at creation time.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived at read time:
                'EMAIL' when an email is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band, derived at read time from 'birthDate' computed
                against 'registrationDate': 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' when 18 to 64,
                'SENIOR' when 65 or older. Null when no birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans: the country code,
                a space, then the national digits grouped in threes (e.g. '+61412345678'
                becomes '+61 412 345 678'). Derived at read time; the raw 'telephone'
                stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                Whether this owner has been soft-deleted. A newly created owner is false;
                DELETE /owners/{id} marks the owner deleted (true) while retaining the record,
                and the create endpoint's duplicate and identity checks ignore deleted owners.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
    OwnerPage:

          title: Total pages

    PetFields:

The only remaining references are in the test itself (which intentionally asserts those old fields are absent). The refactor is complete.

## Summary

I unified `customerCode`, `membershipNumber`, and the derived `checkDigit` into a single stored `memberId` formatted `<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>`, and verified the full suite is green (`Tests run: 1, Failures: 0, Errors: 0 — BUILD SUCCESS`).

**What changed:**

- **New `OwnerMemberId`** (replacing `OwnerCustomerCode`): the single source of truth for the format. `of()` now builds `REGION` + two-digit fiscal year (`FiscalYear.yy`) + 8-upper-hex `HASH8` of SHA-256 over `toE164OrRaw(telephone)+lastName`, then appends a single Luhn `CHK` over the digits of `<REGION><FY><HASH8>`. `regionOf()` now reads the region as the leading run of letters (no separator in the format). Collision `withSuffix` still appends `-<n>`.
- **Pipeline functions**: `AssignCustomerCode`→`AssignMemberId`, `DeduplicateCustomerCode`→`DeduplicateMemberId` (now dedups the `memberId`); removed `AssignMembershipNumber` (the FY is now a segment inside `memberId`).
- **`owners.POST.yml`**: rewired `assignMemberId` → `deduplicateMemberId`, dropped the membership-number step.
- **`Owner` entity**: dropped `customerCode`/`membershipNumber`, added `memberId` (`member_id` column).
- **`OwnerMapper`**: removed the `checkDigit` mapping + Luhn method; `locality` now derives the region from `memberId`. `ownerSegment` references `memberId` transitively via `locality`.
- **Audit**: `AuditOwnerCreated` logs `memberId`; `OwnerCreatedEvent`'s field and JSON key are now `memberId`.
- **Schemas**: all four `schema.sql` dialects drop the two columns for a single `member_id`.
- **`openapi.yml`** (drives `OwnerDto` generation): replaced the `customerCode`/`checkDigit`/`membershipNumber` schemas with a single `memberId`, and refreshed the stale `locality` description.
- Updated stale `{@link}`/doc references in `FiscalYear`, `BusinessDay`, `OwnerTelephone`, `CheckOwnerCityCapacity`, and `AssignHousehold`.

A sample audit line from the run confirms the shape: `memberId=NSW2716E6609E1` (NSW + FY27 + HASH8 `16E6609E` + CHK `1`).

Note: this is not a git repository, so I've made no commit.
